scope: Service facade over shared TaskControl/TaskSubmissionControl; no HarnessRouter runtime dependency

uhp_task_race.log: Targeted UHP and shared submission race tests

official_suite.backend: native Codex protocol demo fixture; no provider calls

regressions: Concurrent same-key retries wait on one atomic task/response/receipt transaction.
Session continuation creates distinct tasks while preserving native thread and workspace.
Streaming disconnect does not cancel work; explicit cancellation retains emitted partial output.
Native fragments emitted during synchronous cancellation are drained before final response freezes.
Credential ownership, file scope, traversal/symlink rejection and corrupt-receipt fail-closed behavior.
Durable receipt replay across restart and response-history deletion.
Existing trace-analysis snapshot test now waits for terminal journal completion; source immutability assertions retained and strengthened.
limitations: No real Codex provider or Kun 0.17.0 runtime end-to-end validation in this environment.
Codex max_step unsupported; Kun uses observable native step count.
Per-request instructions travel as marked task text rather than native system/developer role overrides.
Kun image input unsupported; Codex images require a supporting model.
max_output_tokens and store:false are observably ignored; durable audit/response retention remains enabled.
UHP session deletion/sharing and harness CRUD/plugin/environment/memory management not implemented.
Original artifact references can become changed/missing; historical bytes are never fabricated or silently substituted.
Official suite success on fixture is not a claim of complete normative conformance across all native backends.
